title: Synthesis and structure of a new organolanthanide oxide complex, (CH3C5H4)3Yb4(μ-Cl)6(μ3-Cl)(μ4-O)(THF)3

material_class.structural_family: oxygen-centred Yb4 tetrahedron with edge-bridging μ-Cl, a μ3-Cl over the Cp'-capped face, and three THF on the remaining Yb

synthesis.procedure: Anhydrous YbCl3 (10 mmol) and YbOCl (2.0 mmol) were dissolved in THF (60 ml). Addition of Cp'Na (5.0 mmol; Cp' = C5H4CH3) to this suspension immediately gave a red-brown solution. After stirring for 48 h at room temperature, the mixture was centrifuged to remove the precipitate. The solution was concentrated under reduced pressure to ca. 15 ml and slowly cooled to ca. −20 °C for 48 h, producing pale-red crystalline YbCl3(THF)3 (2) (5% based on Yb). The mother liquor was concentrated to ca. 10 ml and cooled to ca. −40 °C, giving a mixture of primarily red crystals of 1 (40% yield based on Cp') and a small amount of 2 (total yield 6%). Large crystals of 1 and 2 were separated by hand picking. The title cluster is also obtained more slowly from Cp'3Yb, YbCl3 and YbOCl.
synthesis.temperature: stirring at room temperature; crystallization at ca. −20 °C then ca. −40 °C
synthesis.time: 48 h stirring; 48 h at ca. −20 °C for first crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction; centrifugation to remove precipitate; concentration under reduced pressure; cooling crystallization; hand-picking of crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: centrifuge off precipitate; concentrate to ca. 15 ml and cool to ca. −20 °C (gives 2); concentrate mother liquor to ca. 10 ml and cool to ca. −40 °C (gives 1 plus a little 2); separate large crystals by picking

synthesis.procedure: Isolated as a by-product of the same reaction used for 1: YbCl3 (10 mmol) and YbOCl (2.0 mmol) in THF (60 ml) treated with Cp'Na (5.0 mmol). After 48 h stirring at room temperature and centrifugation, concentration to ca. 15 ml and cooling to ca. −20 °C for 48 h gave pale-red crystalline 2 (5% based on Yb). Additional 2 (total yield 6%) co-crystallized with 1 from the further-concentrated mother liquor at ca. −40 °C and was separated by picking crystals.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature reaction; crystallization at ca. −20 °C (and additional crystals at ca. −40 °C)
synthesis.time: 48 h stirring; 48 h crystallization at ca. −20 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same solution reaction and cooling crystallization as for 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: centrifuge; concentrate to ca. 15 ml; cool to ca. −20 °C; additional 2 from mother liquor at ca. −40 °C; hand-picking
